sustainPage.compactTitle: ⚡ Signatory of the 24/7 Carbon-Free Energy Compact
sustainPage.compactBody: Univers is a signatory of the 24/7 Carbon-Free Energy Compact, a global initiative launched by Sustainable Energy for All (SEforALL) in partnership with the United Nations. The commitment goes beyond annual offsetting: matching every unit of electricity consumed with carbon-free generation, in the same location, on an hourly basis. It's the same closed-loop rigor EnOS™ applies to client operations, applied to our own.
